nodes.name: summaries.rs
nodes.summary: Builds and caches per-turn summaries (span, timing) for Cursor IDE sessions, backed by a SQLite cache keyed on a source fingerprint to avoid recomputation.

nodes.name: build_cursor_ide_turn_summaries
nodes.summary: Computes per-turn summaries from a composer's bubble order and raw bubble data.

nodes.name: cursor_ide_summary_source_fingerprint
nodes.summary: Computes a fingerprint over a composer's timestamps and bubble order to detect when cached summaries are stale.

nodes.name: load_cached_cursor_ide_turn_summaries
nodes.summary: Loads previously cached turn summaries for a session if their fingerprint still matches the source.

nodes.name: upsert_cursor_ide_turn_summaries
nodes.summary: Persists computed turn summaries for a session into the SQLite cache.

nodes.name: cache.rs
nodes.summary: SQLite-backed cache layer shared by all 'imported history' sources: upserts, prunes, and queries cached session rows, tracks per-record signatures for change detection, and demotes superseded continuation sessions.

nodes.name: ImportedHistoryCachedSession
nodes.summary: Row shape of a cached imported-history session as stored in and read from the SQLite cache table.

nodes.name: to_row
nodes.summary: Converts an ImportedHistoryCachedSession into its SQL row parameter tuple.

nodes.name: cached_record_signatures_from_conn
nodes.summary: Reads the cached record signatures for a source from the SQLite connection, used to detect changed records.

nodes.name: record_matches_cached_signature
nodes.summary: Compares a discovered record's signature against its cached signature to determine if it changed.

nodes.name: upsert_imported_session_cache_from_conn
nodes.summary: Upserts a batch of imported-history session cache inputs into the SQLite cache.

nodes.name: core_session_record_from_imported_input
nodes.summary: Builds a canonical SessionRecord from an imported-history cache input.

nodes.name: prune_missing_records_from_conn
nodes.summary: Removes cached session rows for a source whose live session ids no longer exist on disk.

nodes.name: query_imported_session_page_from_conn
nodes.summary: Queries a paginated page of cached sessions for a source.

nodes.name: query_imported_sidebar_page_from_conn
nodes.summary: Queries a paginated, date-bounded page of cached sessions with sidebar impact metadata.

nodes.name: query_imported_recent_paths_from_conn
nodes.summary: Queries the most recently updated source paths for a source from the cache.

nodes.name: get_cached_source_path_from_conn
nodes.summary: Looks up the source file path cached for a given session id.

nodes.name: get_cached_source_path_by_suffix_from_conn
nodes.summary: Looks up a cached source path by matching a session id suffix, used for fuzzy resolution.

nodes.name: stat_imported_transcript_by_session_id_from_conn
nodes.summary: Returns lightweight stat metadata for a cached session's source transcript.

nodes.name: metadata_mtime_epoch_ms
nodes.summary: Converts filesystem metadata's modification time into epoch milliseconds.

nodes.name: source_session_counts_from_conn
nodes.summary: Counts cached sessions grouped by source for reporting/telemetry.

nodes.name: query_cached_sessions_from_conn
nodes.summary: Queries a simple paginated list of cached sessions for a source.

nodes.name: query_cached_sessions_by_filter_from_conn
nodes.summary: Queries cached sessions for a source using an arbitrary SQL filter and parameters.

nodes.name: sync_source_cache_from_conn
nodes.summary: Performs a full cache sync for a source: upserts discovered records and prunes missing ones.

nodes.name: query_cached_session_from_conn
nodes.summary: Looks up a single cached session row by source session id.

nodes.name: query_cached_session_by_session_id_from_conn
nodes.summary: Looks up a single cached session row by canonical session id.

nodes.name: query_cached_sessions_for_source_from_conn
nodes.summary: Queries all cached sessions for a given source.

nodes.name: query_cached_sessions_for_repo_from_conn
nodes.summary: Queries cached sessions for a source scoped to a specific repository path.

nodes.name: query_cached_sessions_in_range_from_conn
nodes.summary: Queries cached sessions for a source within a timestamp range.

nodes.name: current_epoch_ms
nodes.summary: Returns the current time as epoch milliseconds.

nodes.name: changed_records_from_conn
nodes.summary: Filters discovered records down to those whose signature differs from the cached value.

nodes.name: live_ids_from_signatures
nodes.summary: Extracts the set of live source session ids from a signatures map.

nodes.name: continuation_group_metadata_json
nodes.summary: Serializes a continuation group key into the JSON metadata stored on cached rows.

nodes.name: demote_superseded_continuations_from_conn
nodes.summary: Demotes older sessions in a continuation chain so only the newest sibling is listed, keeping the rest as hidden children.

nodes.name: cache_tests.rs
nodes.summary: Unit tests for the imported-history SQLite cache: pagination, date-bounded sidebar queries, pruning, signature-based change detection, and continuation-chain election/demotion logic.

nodes.name: fixture_conn
nodes.summary: Creates an in-memory SQLite connection with the imported-history cache schema for tests.

nodes.name: input
nodes.summary: Builds a sample ImportedHistoryCacheInput fixture for use in cache tests.

nodes.name: cache_query_paginates_newest_first
nodes.summary: Verifies cached session queries return pages ordered newest-first.

nodes.name: sidebar_query_is_date_bounded_and_carries_impact_metadata
nodes.summary: Verifies the sidebar query respects date bounds and includes impact metadata.

nodes.name: sidebar_query_paginates_within_one_date_bucket
nodes.summary: Verifies sidebar pagination behaves correctly within a single date bucket.

nodes.name: cache_pruning_is_source_scoped
nodes.summary: Verifies pruning missing records only affects rows belonging to the target source.

nodes.name: cache_signature_comparison_detects_changed_records
nodes.summary: Verifies signature comparison correctly flags records whose content changed.

nodes.name: cache_recent_paths_are_deduped_and_limited
nodes.summary: Verifies recent-paths queries deduplicate and respect the requested limit.

nodes.name: cache_single_session_lookup_returns_source_metadata
nodes.summary: Verifies single-session lookup returns the expected source metadata fields.

nodes.name: cache_canonical_session_lookup_returns_source_and_hidden_rows
nodes.summary: Verifies canonical session id lookup finds both source and demoted/hidden rows.

nodes.name: cache_source_list_filters_unlistable_sessions
nodes.summary: Verifies source-scoped listing filters out unlistable (hidden) sessions.

nodes.name: cache_repo_query_includes_hidden_child_with_inherited_parent_repo
nodes.summary: Verifies repo-scoped queries include hidden child sessions that inherit their parent's repo.

nodes.name: cache_session_page_filters_child_sessions
nodes.summary: Verifies paginated session queries exclude hidden child/continuation sessions.

nodes.name: cache_range_query_is_source_scoped_and_filters_unlistable_sessions
nodes.summary: Verifies range-bounded queries are source-scoped and filter unlistable sessions.

nodes.name: listable_of
nodes.summary: Test helper that marks a fixture session row as listable/unlistable.

nodes.name: continuation_election_demotes_all_but_newest_sibling
nodes.summary: Verifies continuation election keeps only the newest sibling session listed, demoting the rest.

nodes.name: continuation_election_never_promotes_and_skips_subagents
nodes.summary: Verifies continuation election never promotes a hidden session and skips subagent sessions.

nodes.name: managed_mirror.rs
nodes.summary: Tracks which imported-history sessions originate from orgii's own managed mirror directories, so they can be fingerprinted and excluded from double-counting against the original external source.

nodes.name: table_exists
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given table exists in a SQLite connection's schema.

nodes.name: managed_source_session_ids_from_conn
nodes.summary: Loads the set of source session ids that originate from orgii's managed mirror for a given source.

nodes.name: is_managed_source_session_id
nodes.summary: Checks whether a source session id is present in the managed-mirror id set.

nodes.name: append_managed_fingerprint
nodes.summary: Appends a managed-mirror marker to a signature fingerprint so managed and external copies hash differently.

nodes.name: managed_roots.rs
nodes.summary: Helper for enumerating per-profile child directories under orgii's managed mirror root, used when discovering managed session copies.

nodes.name: profile_root_children
nodes.summary: Lists immediate child directories of a managed-mirror profile root whose names match a given suffix.

nodes.name: metadata.rs
nodes.summary: Shared metadata types for the imported-history cache layer: cache input records, record signatures used for change detection, and the impact-stats struct summarizing a session's file edits.

nodes.name: ImportedHistoryImpactStats
nodes.summary: Aggregate stats (files touched, lines added/removed) summarizing a session's edit impact.

nodes.name: ImportedHistoryCacheInput
nodes.summary: Normalized input record written into the imported-history SQLite cache for a discovered session.

nodes.name: ImportedHistoryRecordSignature
nodes.summary: Signature fields used to detect whether a discovered record has changed since it was last cached.

nodes.name: ImportedHistoryDiscoveredRecord
nodes.summary: A freshly discovered session record paired with its computed signature, prior to cache comparison.

nodes.name: is_imported_history_source
nodes.summary: Checks whether a given source identifier belongs to the generic imported-history family of sources.

nodes.name: signature
nodes.summary: Computes the ImportedHistoryRecordSignature for a discovered record.
